implementation.config: account_admission.persist_matches=true requires database_zero+managed player_round; default false, independent of persist_character. Phase1 full recipe enables both.
implementation.key: Actual DB begin_instance epoch + room session/id/generation + monotonic round. Snapshot freezes account/player/slot/character/team/map/start time.
implementation.gate: Bounded instance journal actor (128 commands), normal DB worker, stable retry event/time/key. DB commit/readback before native-facing Start/result; per-batch immutable ticket plus post-await account/current membership/round checks. No room mutex over await.
implementation.lifecycle: Current policy winner unchanged. Departed original participant preserved with left/disconnected. Loading abort/no players/shutdown cancelled, no invented wins. Startup backend cancels old running rows as server_restart/unknown exit. Complete outcomes never changed by restart.
implementation.failure: Busy/queue expiry retry same exact event within5s. Fatal/conflicting/full journal rejects publication and health stops service; unresolved open row is cancelled next boot. No fake successful reply or automatic active-match resume.
implementation.limits: One bounded serial journal actor is a deliberate current-scale design; load/latency/queue budgets and persistent filesystem/power-loss/operations remain M8.

controls.tcp_scope: Actual TCP/SQLite/private launcher, three accounts on common source and sparse next round. Writer lock withholds582/121 and settled175 until commit; active departed winner preserved; old round key rejected/current positive, pending next round cancelled.
controls.kill_scope: Actual serving SIGKILL immediately after first121 or175, quiescent DB/WAL snapshot before cleanup. Fresh instance cancels open row once or preserves exactly committed outcome/zero reward. No power-loss claim. Existing broad fixture records expected interception failure, not relabeled broad-suite pass.
